Subject: knee-above-length white sleeveless open-front priest surcoat worn over a dark silver chainmail long-sleeved shirt with its small standing V collar, long narrow sleeves ending at wrists, and short chainmail shirt skirt ending slightly above the white surcoat hem. Retain the silver bead necklace with silver pendant. Retain the broad double brown waist belt with the original silver round fittings, short chains and two small silver hanging reliquaries with blue accents and short dark red cords, as part of this chest-slot assembly. Empty sleeves in lowered A pose, approximately 27 degrees outward from downward vertical, symmetrical. Hollow neck opening and hollow wrist openings, believable worn three-dimensional volume with no body or mannequin present.
Backdrop: solid clean white, no floor or cast shadow outside the garment. Realistic high-detail fantasy equipment concept rendering, even soft studio lighting, clear fabric weave and chainmail rings, readable construction.
Constraints: NO head, mitre, hair, skin, person, arms or hands, mannequin, legs, chainmail trousers, sandals, boots, gloves, weapons, cape, separate loose items, text, annotations, labels, logo or watermark. Do not change the reference palette or redesign the outfit. Output exactly one front view, no collage.
